prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing, no lyrics. Toy-box folk orchestra. Tin whistle and fiddle lead, accordion chords, marimba and glockenspiel, pizzicato strings, woodblock and tambourine, a bodhran hand drum. Acoustic, warm, wooden, like a painted toy harbour. Background music for the battle phase of a cheerful castle board game: toy cannons pop like a fairground shooting gallery, water splashes, ships tip over like toys, nothing grim. Genre: energetic game battle loop, march. Tempo: 150 BPM. Key: D major with a minor turn in the middle. Mood: driving, exciting, playful, heroic. Arrangement: a snare-drum march pattern throughout, a fanfare-like main theme in the lead, a running bass, a second section with more tension, back to the theme, no slow intro, no ending, constant energy so it loops. About 90 seconds long.
